# Code of conduct

kernable follows the [Contributor Covenant, version 2.1](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).

In short: be respectful and constructive, assume good intent, and keep discussions about the work.
Harassment, insults and personal attacks are not tolerated in issues, pull requests, discussions
or any other project space.

Report unacceptable behaviour to **conduct@kernable.com**. Reports are handled confidentially. The
maintainers may remove comments, close threads, or block anyone who breaks this code.
